# work&edition
```{r}
url <- "https://feeds.librarything.com/feeds/samples/works_to_isbn_small.xml"

response <- GET(
  url,
  add_headers(
    "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
  ),
  config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE) 
)


content_text <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
doc <- xmlParse(content_text, asText = TRUE)
works <- getNodeSet(doc, "/works/work") 


process_work <- function(work) {
  work_attrs <- xmlAttrs(work)
  
  workcode <- as.character(work_attrs[["workcode"]])
  copies <- as.integer(work_attrs[["copies"]])
  isbns_parent <- xmlChildren(work)[["isbns"]]
  if (is.null(isbns_parent)) return(NULL)
  
  isbn_nodes <- getNodeSet(isbns_parent, "./isbn")
  
  isbn_data <- lapply(isbn_nodes, function(isbn) {
    isbn_attrs <- xmlAttrs(isbn)
    data.frame(
      workcode = workcode,
      copies = copies,
      isbn_value = xmlValue(isbn),
      count = as.integer(isbn_attrs[["count"]]),
      uncertain = ifelse("uncertain" %in% names(isbn_attrs), 
                        tolower(isbn_attrs[["uncertain"]]) == "true",
                        NA),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  return(isbn_data)
}

work_editions <- lapply(works, process_work) %>% bind_rows()

write.csv(work_editions, "output.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

```{r}
headers <- add_headers(
  "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
)


get_title_by_workcode <- function(workcode) {

  url <- paste0("https://www.librarything.com/work/", workcode)
  

  response <- GET(url, headers)
  
  if (status_code(response) == 200) {
    html <- content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
    doc <- htmlParse(html, asText = TRUE)

    title <- xpathSApply(doc, "//h1[@id='workTitle']", xmlValue)
    
    if (length(title) > 0) {
      return(trimws(title[1]))  
    } else {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
  } else {
    warning("请求失败，状态码:", status_code(response))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}

work_editions%>%
  mutate(title = sapply(workcode, get_title_by_workcode)
)


```

#rate
```{r}
url <- "https://feeds.librarything.com/feeds/samples/reviews_small.xml"

response <- GET(
  url,
  add_headers(
    "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
  ),
  config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE)  
)


content_text <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
doc <- xmlParse(content_text, asText = TRUE)

reviews <- getNodeSet(doc, "/reviews/review")

process_review <- function(review) {
  # 提取基础字段
  workcode <- xmlValue(review[["workcode"]])
  isbn <- xmlValue(review[["ISBN"]])
  userid <- xmlValue(review[["userid"]])
  stars <- xmlValue(review[["stars"]])
  
  times_node <- review[["times"]]
  written_stamp <- xmlValue(times_node[["written_stamp"]])
  edited_stamp <- xmlValue(times_node[["edited_stamp"]])

  text_node <- review[["text"]]
  review_text <- if (!is.null(text_node)) xmlValue(text_node) else NA_character_

  data.frame(
    workcode = workcode,
    isbn = isbn,
    userid = userid,
    stars = as.numeric(stars),
    written_time = as.POSIXct(as.numeric(written_stamp), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    edited_time = as.POSIXct(as.numeric(edited_stamp), origin = "1970-01-01"),
    review_text = review_text,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

review <- lapply(reviews, process_review) %>% bind_rows()

write.csv(review, "book_reviews.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

# tag
```{r}
url <- "https://feeds.librarything.com/feeds/samples/worktotags_small.xml"

response <- GET(
  url,
  add_headers(
    "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
  ),
  config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE)  
)


content_text <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
doc <- xmlParse(content_text, asText = TRUE)

works <- getNodeSet(doc, "/worktotags/work")

process_work <- function(work) {
  workcode <- xmlGetAttr(work, "workcode")
  
  tag_nodes <- xmlChildren(work)[names(xmlChildren(work)) == "tag"]
  if (length(tag_nodes) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  tag_data <- lapply(tag_nodes, function(tag) {
    data.frame(
      workcode = workcode,
      tag_id = xmlGetAttr(tag, "id"),
      tag_name = xmlValue(tag),
      count = as.integer(xmlGetAttr(tag, "count")),
      aliased_to_id = ifelse("aliasedtoid" %in% names(xmlAttrs(tag)), 
                            xmlGetAttr(tag, "aliasedtoid"), 
                            NA_character_),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  return(tag_data)
}

tags_df <- lapply(works, process_work) %>% bind_rows()

head(tags_df)

write.csv(tags_df, "work_tags.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```


# awards
```{r}
url <- "https://feeds.librarything.com/feeds/samples/awards_small.xml"

response <- GET(
  url,
  add_headers(
    "User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
  ),
  config(ssl_verifypeer = FALSE)  
)


content_text <- content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
doc <- xmlParse(content_text, asText = TRUE)

awards <- getNodeSet(doc, "/awardslist/award")

process_award <- function(award) {
  award_id <- xmlGetAttr(award, "id")
  
  name <- xmlValue(award[["name"]])
  appliesto <- xmlValue(award[["appliesto"]])
  awardtype <- xmlValue(award[["awardtype"]])
  workcount <- as.integer(xmlValue(award[["workcount"]]))
  organization <- xmlValue(award[["organization"]])

  
  org_id <- ifelse(!is.null(award[["organization"]]), 
                  xmlGetAttr(award[["organization"]], "id"), 
                  NA_character_)
  
  data.frame(
    award_id = award_id,
    award_name = name,
    applies_to = appliesto,
    award_type = awardtype,
    organization = organization,
    organization_id = org_id,
    total_works = workcount,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

awards_df <- lapply(awards, process_award) %>% bind_rows()
head(awards_df)
write.csv(awards_df, "awards_list.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```
